description: Every early harness verdict ranked components by invocation count. A guard that rarely fires is working, not dead; and counting a component's NAME in transcripts is contaminated because we discuss them by name.
resolution: Key on the component's own emitted output or real tool_use records, and probe each hook with its actual wired event before deleting it.

name: 30d component usage baseline 2026-08-11
description: 6,426 transcripts, counting tool_use commands not mentions: grep 10879/10 repos, graphify 819/8, mulch 351/3, check-all 339/5, repowise 286/2, ytintel 242/7, semgrep 197/4, retrieve.sh 84/1, memgraph 6/1, drift-replay 3/1.
